summary: Austin Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K on June 2, 2026, reporting results of a CSAMT geophysical survey at its Stockade Mountain Project in Oregon and the termination of its interest in the Kelly Creek Project in Nevada. The press release provides exploration updates: the survey identified resistivity highs associated with known mineralization and additional targets; a water well permit was received; and the company is streamlining its portfolio. This is a routine operational update with no terms, prices, premiums, or structural changes—no special situation event is present.
